ISSUE #535

1st of November 2026
 



News



Kodee’s Kotlin Roundup: Shipaton 2026 Winners, Kotlin 2.5.0-Beta2, and KotlinConf 2027
Kodee rounds up the last few weeks: the Shipaton 2026 winners, Kotlin 2.5.0-Beta2, the State of Kotlin in 2026 report and KotlinConf 2027 in Kraków, whose call for speakers closes November 27.
blog.jetbrains.com

Introducing Gemini 4 Carbon
Koray Kavukcuoglu introduces Gemini 4 Carbon, the new frontier model from Google DeepMind, focused on cybersecurity and long horizon tasks. Cyber defenders and trusted partners get it first, developers will have access soon.
blog.google

What's new in Android developer tools and performance at Android Dev Summit
Adarsh Fernando rounds up the tooling and performance news from Android Dev Summit 2026, from new Android CLI commands for agents to Compose recomposition tracing and R8 in AGP 9.3.
developer.android.com

Your favorite agents are now integrated in Android Studio
Matthew Warner announces that Android Studio Rabbit 2 is stable, and with it Bring Your Own Agent, which brings more than 40 coding agents into the IDE.
developer.android.com



Sponsored



Coroutines Mastery starts next week — join now and evaluate the course during the first 3 days
Coroutines Mastery starts next week. Join the cohort, attend the initial sessions, review the materials, and decide whether the format and depth are right for you. If not, you can request a full refund within 3 days from the course start. There is still time to join.
coroutinesmastery.com

Understand Kotlin Flow faster with a free cheat sheet you'll use in every reactive programming project
Master the essentials of Kotlin Flow with a free cheat sheet designed for everyday development. Quickly look up builders, operators, StateFlow, SharedFlow, flow combinations, buffering, and collection methods without interrupting your workflow.
cheat-sheet.kt.academy



Multiplatform



What I learned shipping a running app with Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose, and a native Apple Watch app
Steven Rogers shares what he learned building a running coach app on his own with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose, while keeping the Apple Watch and Wear OS parts native.
fluxrunai.com

Parse reminder dates in Kotlin Multiplatform - an offline KMP walkthrough
A walkthrough on parsing reminder dates like 'tomorrow from 5PM to 8PM' offline, in shared KMP code with DateParser Kotlin.
alox1d.github.io



Sponsored



Can your mobile release handle AI-generated code?
AI multiplied the code your team writes. But the process that delivers it to users hasn't changed: same release trains, same quality gates, same manual handoffs. Join a live panel with mobile engineering leaders on what that volume changes about the release process. Nov 12, 10am PT/1pm ET.
www.runway.team



Libraries



kotlin-compiler-go
A prototype Kotlin compiler for the JVM written in Go, that claims to be ten times faster than kotlinc. It does not compile all of Kotlin yet
github.com

ktrs
ktrs rewrites ktfmt and ktlint in Rust, with byte-identical output and no JVM to start.
github.com

Orrery
A month, week and year calendar for Compose Multiplatform, with Material 3 theming and a optional Chinese lunisolar module.
github.com

Mosaic
Nicholas Abbott's Mosaic is a Kotlin framework to build backend responses out of Tiles, small units of work that compose each other and share repeated work within a request.
github.com

bikesched
A job scheduler for Java and Kotlin backed by PostgreSQL, with durable steps, events and retries. It is at a very early stage, expect it to break.
github.com

proctor
proctor lets you write an eval suite once in Kotlin Multiplatform and run it against Gemini Nano on Android and Apple Foundation Models on iOS.
github.com

kinuvo
A self-hosted personal AI assistant built with Kotlin, whose agents remember you across conversations.
github.com

Contribute

ISSUE #534

25th of October 2026
 



Articles



The Evolution of Statics: Say Goodbye to Kotlin Companion Objects?
Nav Singh looks at the companion blocks and companion extensions coming in Kotlin 2.5, and what they change compared to the companion objects we have been using for years.
proandroiddev.com

Flake-Free Flow Tests in Kotlin - Hardening Coroutine Tests
Kevin Schildhorn explains why coroutine tests turn flaky once real threads, real dispatchers or shared state get involved, and how to keep the test in control
touchlab.co

BDD Without Gherkin
Paul Brooks makes the case for keeping Given-When-Then examples in plain test code instead of in separate feature files.
kensa.dev

AI Can Write My Kotlin. Who's Going to Debug It at 2 AM?
Now that agents can write and fix Android code, Mayank Kumar asks what is left of the Android engineer's job.
imayankkumar.com

Hacktoberfest: 13 small, well-described issues in a Kotlin library for AI agents
Hacktoberfest ends the 31st of October. If you are looking for a Kotlin pull request to make, Manuel Alejandro Hermoso has a list of beginner friendly issues in Telar.
dev.to



Sponsored



Bring a colleague or friend to Coroutines Mastery for free and learn coroutines together
Learning coroutines is easier when you have someone to compare ideas with. With the Coroutines Mastery 1+1 promotion, buy one seat and add a colleague or friend for free. After purchase, email us their name and email address and we’ll add them to the course.
coroutinesmastery.com

Level up your Jetpack Compose skills with a free advanced cheat sheet built for production apps
Keep advanced Jetpack Compose concepts close at hand with a free cheat sheet. Explore state management, side effects, custom layouts, performance optimization, animations, and other techniques used in production-ready Android apps.
cheat-sheet.kt.academy



Android



The Sentry Android SDK is now 20-30% faster!
Nelson Osacky goes through the more than 40 changes the Sentry team made to speed up the initialization of their Android SDK, and how they measured it.
blog.sentry.io

How I Built an Open-Source, Low-Latency Virtual Gamepad for Android Using Kotlin and UDP
Ishan did not want to buy a controller for PC gaming, so he turned his phone into one.
ishan09811.medium.com



Multiplatform



Swift packages in Kotlin Multiplatform - built-in SwiftPM import with Kotlin 2.4.x
Krzysztof Dąbrowski uses Google Nearby Connections, whose iOS SDK ships as a Swift package, to show how the built-in SwiftPM import in Kotlin 2.4 works in a KMP project.
proandroiddev.com

Box, Box: Deep Links in Kotlin Multiplatform | KMP Bits
KMP Bits wires up deep links from push notifications in an app where Android and iOS share a single navigation layer.
medium.com



Videos



Inside Airbnb's UI Motion Architecture | KotlinConfersations
Airbnb engineers Tunji Dahunsi and Rahul Behara talk with Wenda at KotlinConf about building fluid UI animations without draining the battery, and about balancing the platform guidelines with their own design system.
www.youtube.com

KMP Contest Winners | KotlinConfersations 2026
Javier and Adrien, two of the winners of the Kotlin Multiplatform Contest, present the apps they built. The new edition is open to students and recent graduates until December 7, with three trips to KotlinConf 2027 in Kraków as prizes.
www.youtube.com



Sponsored



Can your mobile release handle AI-generated code?
AI multiplied the code your team writes. But the process that delivers it to users hasn't changed: same release trains, same quality gates, same manual handoffs. Join a live panel with mobile engineering leaders on what that volume changes about the release process. Nov 12, 10am PT/1pm ET.
www.runway.team



Libraries



T3 JetBrains Plugin
Isuru Rajapakse's unofficial plugin brings T3 Code into JetBrains IDEs, with threads, tool calls and permission prompts in a tool window and files, diffs and terminals handled by the IDE itself.
github.com

Starfait
Starfait is a re-implementation of the GameMaker: Studio runner in Kotlin, targeting Undertale v1.08, and the True Pacifist route is already playable.
github.com

ggwave-kmp
A Kotlin Multiplatform wrapper around ggwave to send short messages through sound on Android, iOS and the JVM.
github.com

NucleusJvmAccess
NucleusJvmAccess is a highly experimental project that lets Kotlin Multiplatform apps on Android and iOS call Java libraries on a real JVM running inside the app process. A Gradle plugin generates the proxies, so shared code calls them like local Kotlin.
github.com

Tellyscope
Tellyscope lets you debloat you Android TV, install apps and transfer files to it from your phone, without root and without a PC.
github.com

ISSUE #533

18th of October 2026
 



News



What Makes a Great KotlinConf Proposal?
The KotlinConf 2027 Call for Papers is open and closes the 27th of November. Jelena Ilic gathers advice from speakers and program committee members on shaping a proposal, including what reviewers notice first.
blog.jetbrains.com

Google Summer of Code 2026 With the Kotlin Foundation: Recap
Ksenia Shneyveys looks back at the two projects completed this year, one on the Kotlin/Wasm backend and one mapping where Kotlin is taught around the world.
blog.jetbrains.com

Bringing our latest frontier model to Android Developers
Gemini 4 Argon is now available to Android developers in Antigravity, Android Studio and Google AI Studio. Jason Buchel looks at how it handles Android work, from failing Gradle builds to Compose UI.
developer.android.com



Articles



An AI agent that asks before it pays: human approval for tool calls in Kotlin
Manuel Alejandro Hermoso builds a help desk agent with Telar that has to stop and wait for a human before it can issue a refund.
dev.to

AWS Lambda Response Streaming for Kotlin and Java
Elena van Engelen - Maslova shows how to stream HTTP responses from a Kotlin or Java Lambda sitting behind API Gateway.
medium.com

KotlinConf Recap: Lessons from Verifone's Architect on Kotlin in Mission-Critical Payments
Aniket Bhattacharyea recaps Yuri Geronimus's KotlinConf 2026 talk on leaning on the Kotlin type system to keep payment code in line with the specs it implements
blog.jetbrains.com



Sponsored



Coroutines Mastery 1+1: enroll once and bring another Kotlin developer with you for free
For a limited time, one Coroutines Mastery enrollment includes a second seat free. Buy your seat first, then email us the second participant’s name and email address and we’ll add them to the course. Bring a teammate, colleague, or friend and learn coroutines together.
coroutinesmastery.com

Master Jetpack Compose faster with a free cheat sheet designed for everyday Android development work
Keep the most useful Jetpack Compose concepts in one place. This free cheat sheet helps you quickly find layouts, modifiers, state, side effects, animations, lazy lists, and other building blocks needed to create modern Android interfaces.
cheat-sheet.kt.academy



Android



Jetpack Compose Performance skill
Google has added a Jetpack Compose performance skill to the official Android skills, so your agent can track down recomposition overhead, dropped frames and UI lag in existing Compose code.
github.com

Device Streaming and Android skills - available in Android CLI
Simona Milanovic covers the latest Android CLI updates, including access to real devices through Android Device Streaming, and takes a closer look at the Wear Compose Material 3 skill.
developer.android.com

Build your way: Use any AI agent of your choice in Android Studio
Matthew Warner introduces Bring Your Own Agent in Android Studio Canary, which lets you plug Claude Agent, Codex or Antigravity into the IDE.
developer.android.com



Multiplatform



Publishing one Kotlin Multiplatform library to six places: Maven Central, SPM, pub.dev
Shiva Thapa walks through shipping his Nepali Date Picker from a single Kotlin Multiplatform codebase to Maven Central, Swift Package Manager, pub.dev, npm, PyPI and GitHub Pages, and what each of them wants from you.
medium.com

Telemetry: Shared Analytics and Crash Reporting in Kotlin Multiplatform | KMP Bits
KMP Bits moves analytics and crash reporting into commonMain, so Android and iOS stop drifting apart.
medium.com

Moving from SKIE to Swift export in a Kotlin Multiplatform project
John O'Reilly goes through what it took to move the SwiftUI client of PeopleInSpace from SKIE to Swift export.
johnoreilly.dev



Conferences



Android Makers is back
Android Makers is back next year as Mobile Makers! All your latest Android, Kotlin and Flutter news, 100% organized by the community. Join them in Paris on April 30th 2027. Tickets and CFP are open now.
mobilemakers.fr



Libraries



Telar
Telar lets you build AI agents and workflows in Kotlin Multiplatform as small typed graphs.
github.com

Prosa.kt
Alex Styl's Prosa.kt is a declarative API for generating Kotlin source code, written in pure Kotlin.
github.com

Ketch
Ketch is an open source download manager for desktop, Android, iOS, the web and the command line, which splits each download across parallel connections. The engine behind it is a Kotlin Multiplatform library on Maven Central that you can embed in you own app.
github.com

kotlinstall
kotlinstall installs Kotlin/Native command line programs straight from a GitHub repository, building them with Gradle and linking the binaries into your path. It runs on macOS and Linux.
github.com

Verceltics
Apoorv Darshan's Verceltics lets you check deployments, domains, DNS, analytics and uptime across many hosting providers from your phone. The Android app is native Kotlin with Jetpack Compose.
github.com
